extracted.name: Singapore Noodle Curry Shrimp
extracted.description: Wonderful dish for entertaining or a busy weeknight meal; you can bring this ginger-infused Singapore shrimp curry dish to your table in less than 30 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 (8 ounce) package rice noodles, broken into 3 inch pieces and soaked
4 green onions, chopped into 1 inch pieces
1 (12 ounce) package frozen cooked cocktail shrimp
instruction_lines: Soak rice noodles according to package directions. Drain well and set aside.
Combine chicken broth, oyster sauce, soy sauce, and sugar in a small bowl; set aside.

Heat peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add curry powder, garlic, and ginger; stir-fry for 10 seconds. Add peppers, onions, and scallions; stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in broth mixture and bring to a boil over high heat. Add shrimp and peas, and cook until hot. Add noodles and cook until the dish is heated thoroughly. Serve immediately with lime wedges.
